notes: Text rules replace only the listed spoiler phrases at their field paths; ordinary names, addresses, dates and surrounding prose stay readable. Generic outcome words are masked individually by the presentation layer.
An array can be traversed without a selector, or scoped by title/name/placeId. Photo fields cover revealing screen frames only; real-place photographs remain visible.
Death-victim lists are sensitive associations. Names remain available in ordinary character associations, while victim identities stay covered in death-only lists.
The former whole-record flags are intentionally removed. A late scene does not make its entire description or address a spoiler.
